summary: The change clears the group status on multiline custom paste and row removal, and calls updateSaveState after the custom paste path prevents the native event, so the card dirty badge and stale success feedback update immediately.

evidence: public/admin_projects.js line 151 clears the group status before rendering the custom-paste values.
public/admin_projects.js lines 207-210 clear the group status after a row removal.
public/admin_projects.js line 222 calls updateSaveState(article) after the custom paste is handled and the native event is prevented.
public/admin_projects.js line 517 passes the project article into wireRows, enabling the paste dirty-state refresh.
